what: Cells painted in the upper board’s color cover the top of the lower board in a staggered stair-step pattern, row by row. When the section reaches 80% of the screen, they flicker away in random order (.08s apart): opacity .2 (.04s) → 1 (.06s) → .2 and left 1% (.02s) → 1 (.05s) → 0 (.06s). Remaining cells (data-fx-part="keep") alone remains stepped so the boundary of the two panels is torn like pixel stairs. Cells without a mark are empty from the start so the panel below shows through

options.shift: Horizontal shift on blink (cell width %), default 1
options.look: short — blinks only three times (low-spec version of the original)

from.where: index.html .ec-steps (boundary from message → results · spark · topic)
